sourceText: The DONE intent-equivalence lightweight heuristic in packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts (claimsShrinkage regex over summary changes/actualTranscript/outcomeDiff/limitations) false-positives on file paths and code identifiers: during B-d6a0 the literal file name core/partial-done-recovery.ts in summary.changes matched \bpartial\b (hyphen = word boundary) and blocked DONE with unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage until the summary was reworded. Make the heuristic ignore path-like/code-like tokens (skip matches inside segments/with/slashes, hyphen-ated-file.ts names, or backticked spans) and add a regression test using a summary that names partial-done-recovery.ts. Also consider whether remaining (which matched an earlier draft describing pre-existing unrelated suite failures) is too broad a trigger word.
normalizedOutcome: The claimsShrinkage heuristic no longer triggers on path-like/code-like tokens (backticked spans, slash-segmented paths, hyphenated/dotted file names) while genuine prose shrinkage claims still trigger; a regression smoke case names partial-done-recovery.ts and passes; an explicit keep/narrow/drop decision for the bare trigger word remaining is recorded and implemented.
acceptanceClaim: done_intent_equivalence_check on a lightweight-path story whose summary names core/partial-done-recovery.ts reports no unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap; the existing narrow-delivery positive control still reports the gap; the proofstory-intent-hardening smoke passes with the new regression case; the remaining-breadth decision is documented in story artifacts.
